concerns.text: Tasks T018c (Zenodo), T018d-1 (NIST), and T018e (ArXiv) contain empty or placeholder URLs (e.,g., 'verified Zenodo record ``'). FR-001 mandates ingestion from specific open repositories. A task with a missing URL cannot satisfy the requirement to 'ingest... from specified open repositories' and effectively weakens the constraint by making the task impossible to execute as written.

Task T018g-gen ('Generate Curated Literature Dataset') lists a URL ' (Citation: DOI: 10.1111/jace.18342)' with an empty URL field. This violates FR-001's requirement to ingest from specified repositories and Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) which requires valid, reachable citations. The task cannot fulfill the data ingestion requirement with a missing source.

Task T018e references a Zenodo DOI '``' (empty). FR-001 requires ingestion from arXiv/specified repositories. An empty DOI/URL prevents the task from satisfying the requirement to fetch data from a 'verified Zenodo record', constituting a semantic weakening of the data source constraint.

Task T018d-1 references a NIST URL 'https://...' (placeholder) and a landing page 'https://...' (placeholder). FR-001 requires ingestion from NIST. Without a valid, specific URL, the task cannot satisfy the requirement to 'fetch data from the verified NIST Materials Data API endpoint', weakening the constraint.

Task T017b ('Implement Data Gap Validation & Report') depends on T017c (test data generation) which is marked [X] but T017c's description specifies creating 'data/raw/test_n.csv' with 29 rows. However, T017b's verification step requires 'final_count.txt' (from T018f-5a) which is marked [ ]. If T018f-5a is not completed, T017b cannot verify the N < 30 condition, weakening the SC-004 constraint enforcement.

Task T054-stream-test implements a streaming test for >100,000 rows. The Spec's 'Assumptions' section explicitly states the dataset will be <5,000 samples and fit in 7GB RAM. While not a direct FR weakening, this task introduces a scope drift (testing for a dataset size 20x larger than the assumed constraint) which may violate the 'Computational Stability' principle if it forces the implementation to handle edge cases not required by the spec.

Task T018g-gen is a 'Generate' task that creates a dataset from a URL. The Spec/Plan requires ingesting from 'open repositories' (FR-001). If the URL in T018g-gen is a static CSV hosted on a personal repo or a non-standard source not listed in FR-001 (Materials Project, NIST, arXiv), this task silently relaxes the requirement to use 'specified open repositories' by substituting an unverified fallback source.
